P7657.corridor_notes: ~45-46km branch line linking the Liuzhou distribution station (Taiyangcun Town, Liunan District) to a newly built Liucheng distribution station (Shapu Town, Liucheng County), passing through the Luoman (洛满) and Shechong (社冲) valve chambers en route. Per liucheng.gov.cn, ~28km of the route lies within Liucheng County itself; per gxtngs.com.cn, total new pipeline is ~46km across both Liunan District and Liucheng County (close to GEM's LengthKnown=45km). Design pressure ~4 MPa per GEM.
P7657.researcher_notes: Builds on the prior pilot pass, which already established existence/route/length via these same three refs (all three originally-cited sheet refs -- njsggzy.cn, fgw.gxzf.gov.cn, fgw.liuzhou.gov.cn -- are dead and should be swapped for these). This pass re-verified all three refs live via url_verifier.py and re-fetched the two gxtngs.com.cn EIA notices directly (raw curl, not AI-summarized) to confirm the literal route/station text: '本工程位于柳州市柳南区和柳城县，新建管道线路全长约46km，扩建柳州分输站，新建柳城分输站、洛满阀室和社冲阀室。' Diameter (323.9mm), capacity, pressure, cost, and exact proposal/construction/start dates remain unconfirmed by any live source (pilot's separate spec-concern entry) -- out of scope for endpoint geocoding but flagged for the record. Endpoint precision: start resolved to village level (新圩村), matching P7673's shared origin station; end resolved to town level (沙浦镇), with the more specific expressway-service-area descriptor sourced from GEM's own field rather than an independently found document.

P7673.corridor_notes: 27km branch line from a China-Myanmar-gas-pipeline transmission station in Liushan Town, Liujiang District, passing through twelve villages, to the Liuzhou distribution station in Taiyangcun Town, Liunan District (china5e.com: '该管道起于中缅天然气管道支干线柳州输气站...终于柳南区太阳村镇新圩村柳州分输站...沿线经过柳江区、柳南区两个区'; sohu.com station-chief quote gives the village-level detail: '起点是在柳江区流山镇流山村柳州输气站，经过十二个村到柳南区太阳村镇新圩村柳州分输站'). Overall direction northwest-to-southeast. Construction started 2015-08-28; entered trial operation 2017-12-05. Design capacity 3.70x10^8 Nm3/yr (0.37 bcm/y), matching GEM exactly.
P7673.researcher_notes: Builds directly on the prior pilot pass, which had already verified existence/route/length/capacity/construction-date via these same three refs but only had a paraphrased route description (district-level only). This pass fetched china5e.com and sohu.com directly (raw curl, not AI-summarized) and extracted the literal station names and village-level route description, upgrading endpoint precision from district-level to village-level for both ends. Note the three refs (china5e.com, tzcjj.liuzhou.gov.cn per pilot, sohu.com) all trace to one original wire story per project rules and do not count as 2 independent sources on their own; jz.docin.com (the EIA-filing listing, uploaded by a different party in 2020) is the genuinely separate second origin. Prior pilot's flagged StartMonth1 concern (sheet says 2017-05; sources say trial operation began Dec 2017) is a data-field issue outside this task's endpoint-geometry scope but is reiterated here for the record.

end.name_en: Luzhai Distribution Station (Luzhai County) -- newly built under this project
end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '鹿寨县' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E9%B9%BF%E5%AF%A8%E5%8E%BF) -- used the county-seat/city-type node (place_rank 16) rather than the wider county administrative boundary centroid, for a tighter anchor. Station name from same EIA notice: '管道出阀室后绕过柳东新区规划区后向东南方向敷设至鹿寨分输站'.

P7674.corridor_notes: ~31km branch line running from the Liudong distribution station (Liudong New District) via Fulutun, Liangting Village and Diliao into Liucheng County; the line then routes around the Liudong New District planning area, turning northeast through Dashan Village, Sijiao and Shanchang into Luzhai County; continues northeast via Baihua Village to the Luorong (雒容) valve room; then heads southeast (again routing around the Liudong New District planning area) to the new Luzhai distribution station. Length breakdown matches GEM exactly: 4.3km in Liudong New District + 6.9km in Liucheng County + 19.8km in Luzhai County = 31.0km total. Design capacity 1.1x10^8 Nm3/yr, design pressure 6.3 MPa, diameter DN300; one new station (Luzhai distribution station) and one new valve room (Luorong) built, plus expansion of the Liudong distribution station. Note: the source text references bypassing the Liudong New District planning area twice (once near the start of the route, again near the end just before reaching the Luzhai distribution station) -- reads as a possible drafting quirk/repetition in the original EIA text rather than a real routing detail; flagged, not resolved.
P7674.researcher_notes: Best-documented of this batch's four PIDs. The prior pilot pass had already located this exact wsbs.liuzhou.gov.cn EIA public notice with a route description whose per-county length breakdown matches GEM's LengthMergedKm to the decimal. This pass re-fetched the page directly (raw curl, after an earlier WebFetch attempt on a different URL pattern returned ECONNRESET; not AI-summarized) to confirm the verbatim Chinese route text and extract literal station/place names (柳东分输站, 鹿寨分输站, 雒容阀室) for geocoding. Despite additional searching, this remains a SINGLE-SOURCE finding -- no second independent document was found by either pass. Per the project's 2+ independent source rule this would rate medium (not high) confidence on the standard corroboration scale, even though the route/length detail is unusually specific and internally consistent with GEM's own figures.
P7674.blockers: Only one independent source (wsbs.liuzhou.gov.cn) found for this segment despite targeted searching in both this pass and the prior pilot pass; does not meet the 2+ independent source corroboration target even though the single source is detailed and highly consistent with GEM's own data.

P7680.corridor_notes: GEM records this as a 29km branch pipeline entirely within Xincheng County (Laibin prefecture), operator 广西广投天然气管网有限公司 (Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co. -- the same operator as the other three sibling branches in this batch, and the builder named in the Xincheng County EPB notice). No EIA public notice, land-use approval, bidding notice, or news report naming specific stations, townships, or a start/end alignment within the county was found in this pass or the prior pilot pass, despite targeted Chinese-language searching. A site search on gxtngs.com.cn (the EIA consultancy that published the detailed route notices used for P7657 and P7674) returned zero hits for '忻城'. DuckDuckGo-HTML search (used as a WebSearch substitute after the session's WebSearch budget was exhausted) returned no usable results either.
P7680.researcher_notes: Resolves the prior pilot pass's core existence puzzle: the pilot's extensive search for a literal 'Xincheng'/'新城' place name in Laibin came up empty because 'Xincheng' in GEM's fields is a romanization of 忻城 (Xincheng County, an established Guangxi county under Laibin City), not a mistransliterated or fictional name -- confirmed by cross-referencing the GEM CSV's OtherLanguageAlternativePipelineNames field, which this pass consulted directly. Re-searching with the correct Chinese term ('忻城天然气支线管道') immediately surfaced a NEW existence confirmation the pilot missed: 忻城县环境保护局 (Xincheng County Environmental Protection Bureau) issued a formal EIA approval public notice dated 2018-06-04, titled '忻城县环境保护局关于广西天然气支线管网项目忻城天然气支线管道工程审批公示', independently naming this exact project and stating '建设地点：忻城县' (construction location: Xincheng County). This document's canonical URL had to be recovered from the page's own <meta name='Url'> tag after an initially guessed URL 404'd; the recovered URL passes url_verifier.py live. This source is independent of and postdates the pilot's two docin.com/doc88.com EIA-report-listing refs (also re-verified live in this pass), giving 2 independent sources confirming existence and general (county-level) location -- a real upgrade from the pilot's 'concern/existence' verdict (zero verifiable support at all) to 'existence confirmed at county level, route detail unknown.' Despite this upgrade, NO source found by either pass states a station name, township, or any sub-county route detail -- GEM's own Start/EndLocation fields are both simply 'Xincheng', and no finer document exists in the government-portal or consultancy sites searched. Since start and end therefore resolve to the identical county-seat coordinate, this cannot support route geometry; PARTIAL resolution reflects a genuine documentation gap, not a search shortfall.
P7680.blockers: No station-level or township-level endpoint detail exists in any source found across two research passes (prior pilot + this one). Start and end both collapse to the Xincheng county-seat centroid, which is insufficient for route drawing. If GEM's own StartLocation/EndLocation is ever updated with a more specific place name (e.g. a township or station name), this row should be re-researched; until then, no candidate route geometry can be drawn beyond 'somewhere within Xincheng County'.
